title: Katseye to hold first solo concert in Korea
caption:
Katseye is officially bringing The Wildworld Tour to Seoul's Kspo Dome. This marks the group's first solo concert in Korea since their 2024 debut.

Source: Koreaherald - Katseye to hold first solo concert in Korea
